data.one_liner: Flutter implementation of slidable list item with directional slide actions and dismissal.
data.what_it_does: Provides a slidable list item widget that supports left/top (start) and right/bottom (end) action panes with multiple built-in motions like behind, drawer, scroll, and stretch. It allows users to reveal slide actions or dismiss the item entirely with custom or built-in animations.
use_when: You need list items with swipe actions like delete, archive, or edit.
You want configurable slide action motions such as scroll, stretch, drawer, or behind effects.
avoid_when: Your app does not use the required material_ui package (required since v5.0.0).
You require complex multi-step swipe gestures that go beyond standard list item side actions.
strengths: Recognized as a Flutter Favorite package.
Multiple built-in motion animations and action pane layouts.
weaknesses: Requires the app to be migrated to the decoupled material_ui package starting from version 5.0.0.
Strict minimum Flutter and Dart version requirements.
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_slidable to pubspec.yaml and ensure your app uses the material_ui package if using built-in actions.
data.minimal_example:
Slidable(
  key: const ValueKey(0),
  startActionPane: ActionPane(
    motion: const ScrollMotion(),
    children: const [
      SlidableAction(
        onPressed: doNothing,
        backgroundColor: Color(0xFFFE4A49),
        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
        icon: Icons.delete,
        label: 'Delete',
      ),
    ],
  ),
  child: const ListTile(title: Text('Slide me')),
)
